verdict.rationale: The pack contains no evidence about a hosted free plan: nothing on free-tier quotas, project limits, pausing behavior, or whether it is enough to run a real prototype. The only pricing-adjacent item says daily backups apply to Pro, Team and Enterprise projects, which implies a lower tier exists but says nothing about its usability. A keyless local CLI and self-hosting are ways to avoid paying, but they are not a free tier of the hosted service.
